messages:
Priya: hey team, opened PR to refresh the hello-tiles quickstart — fixes auth snippets and first-deploy docker-compose example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912 — need eyes on node snippet and the compose ports.
Connor: looking now. noticed the Node example still references client.call(), which was renamed in SDK v5. should use client.generate().
Eve: thanks — also the python example sets REDWOOD_TOKEN while the node example expects REDWOOD_API_KEY. we should standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY across all snippets.
Priya: good catch. i made the python change in the branch and pushed. left a note in the PR about standardizing the env var.
Sam: CI shows a broken link on the deploy page: the relative anchor to "#expose-your-service" 404s after site build. probably due to header rename.
docs-bot: link-checker: 1 broken link found in docs/quickstarts/hello-tiles.md -> ./deploy.md#expose-your-service (404)
Connor: i'll update the deploy page header back to the expected anchor and add a redirect alias to be safe.
Eve: small style nit: code fence language in the README is labeled js but contains TypeScript syntax (type annotations). lint flagged it.
Priya: OK i'll change the fence to typescript and drop the explicit types for the quickstart since it aims for minimal friction.
Sam: compose file needs explicit port mapping for local run. changed service to `ports: - "3000:3000"` in the PR. also added HEALTHCHECK to reduce flakiness in CI.
deploy-bot: preview site deployed to http://deploy-preview-912--docs.redwood-ai.com/ (staging) — quick test link: /quickstarts/hello-tiles
Priya: preview looks good, but the sample output for the tiles generator differs from local due to deterministic seed not being set. can someone confirm whether we should pin seed in examples?
Connor: i'd avoid pinning seed in docs; instead add a one-line note that outputs will vary and include an example result rather than exact text.
Eve: added that wording in a follow-up commit and updated the sample screenshot alt text.
Priya: final checklist before merge: 1) standardize env var (done) 2) replace client.call -> client.generate (Connor) 3) fix link alias (Connor) 4) code fence languages (Priya) 5) compose ports + healthcheck (Sam) 6) add migration note for SDK v5 (Priya).
Connor: PR updated with client.generate changes and anchor alias. 
Sam: ran local smoke and the compose run serves on 3000 as expected. added brief troubleshoot FAQ for common bind issues.
docs-bot: CI: lint passed; link-checker passed; spellcheck found 1 suggestion (tiles-generator -> Tiles generator).
Priya: will merge after I re-run the staging preview checks. planning to tag a patch docs release post-merge. ETA 20-30m.
Eve: :thumbsup: small follow-up — can we add a short blurb in the migration guide about env var naming to reduce support tickets?
Priya: added to the migration guide draft in the PR description.

---

Snippet (Node) from PR for reviewers:
```ts
// minimal
import { Redwood } from "@redwood/inference";
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const out = await client.generate({ model: "tiles-small", prompt: "make a 3x3 icon grid" });
console.log(out.text);
```

Action items (post-merge): Priya - tag release + update changelog; Connor - follow-up redirect PR if any 404s crop up; Sam - monitor deploy preview health; Eve - file migration-guide PR for env var note.
